name: HOA
description: A strict homeowners-association president in her mid fifties, a woman who polices every lawn but secretly loves barbershop harmony and a cappella singing.
build: A trim, upright adult build of ordinary height: squared shoulders, a straight posture, a narrow waist, arms and legs of ordinary length, standing upright with straight knees.
face: Fair pinkish skin, sharp blue eyes under thin arched brows, a narrow straight nose, defined cheekbones, and thin lips in pink-coral lipstick.
hair: A short, stiff, perfectly set platinum-blonde bob, chin length, rounded and solid below the visor.
outfit: A bright white sun visor with a wide flat kelly-green bill; a sleeveless kelly-green polo shirt with a white collar, buttoned up; a big round white lanyard badge on a wide green cord at the chest; white capri trousers to mid-calf with a wide brown belt; white tennis shoes. Both arms and hands are bare.
performance_style: Rigid and watchful: feet together, back straight, chin up. The character-right hand held open at the waist, palm up as if reading; the character-left hand raised open with the index finger up, making a point, fingers visible. A tight polite smile.
location: A perfectly kept suburban backyard: an immaculate striped green lawn running to the bottom of the frame, identical trimmed boxwood hedges, a white vinyl fence, a white gazebo behind, and neat white string lights.
recognition_cues: a white visor with a kelly-green bill
a kelly-green polo with a big white badge
palette: visor, badge, capris and shoes white #F4F2EC / #C0BCB2 / #FFFFFF
visor bill, polo and cord kelly-green #2A9A48 / #186630 / #56C472
avoid: a clipboard on the key art

sing.intent: Barbershop vocal loop: a crisp side-step and tip of the visor, the mic in the character-right hand at the mouth, the character-left hand conducting a tidy harmony line at chest height, then return to the rigid stance. The mouth visibly opens and changes shape across the loop so the character unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: A sharp start at a loud stereo: shoulders snap up, both open hands rise, then she smooths the bob back into place. No opponent or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot: hold the character-left hand up palm-out, 'stop right there', feet together, then hold. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot: march in heel-toe, stop square to the front and hold up the pointing finger in the rigid stance.
